title: Furniture Dismantling & Reassembly Birmingham
metaTitle: Furniture Dismantling & Reassembly Birmingham | Jimmys Removals
metaDescription: Professional furniture dismantling and assembly in Birmingham. Sliding wardrobes, ottoman beds, dining tables and flat-pack reassembly by insured movers.
heroSubheading: Furniture dismantling and reassembly in Birmingham for wardrobes (including IKEA PAX), bunk beds, ottoman beds and dining tables. We bag and label every fixing, wrap each panel for transit, and rebuild everything in your new home so your beds are ready on the first night.
summary: Oversized wardrobes, ottoman beds, and multi-leaf dining tables rarely fit through narrow Victorian doorways or stairwells without careful disassembly. Our Birmingham removal company carries specialized tooling to dismantle flat-pack and solid timber furniture efficiently prior to loading. Our uniformed movers carefully bag all fixings, transport the components wrapped in protective blankets, and expertly reassemble your beds and furnishings in your new home so you can sleep comfortably on your first night.
benefits: Expert handling of multi-door sliding wardrobes and complex ottoman frames
All bolts, screws, and brackets catalogued and bagged safely per item
Professional power drivers, hex sets, and specialist assembly hand tools
Safe navigation of tight doorways and spiral stairwells without damage
Full reassembly and levelling in your chosen room before sign-off

process.title: Furniture Inspection
process.description: We identify which items require dismantling to pass through doors and assess original manufacture fixings.

process.title: Careful Deconstruction
process.description: Panels, doors, and internal shelving are gently disassembled. Fixings are sealed in labelled hardware pouches attached to frames.

process.title: Protective Transit Wrapping
process.description: Glass doors, mirrored panels, and timber pieces are wrapped in heavy transit blankets to prevent scratches.

process.title: Precision Reconstruction
process.description: At your new home, our team rebuilds each item, ensuring hinges are aligned, drawers slide smoothly, and frames are level.

whatsIncluded: Full dismantling and reconstruction of agreed furniture items
All necessary professional tools, screwdrivers, and hex keys
Labelling, bagging, and securing of all hardware and screws
Protective wrapping of individual panels and mirrored components
Insurance protection throughout dismantling and rebuild
whatsNotIncluded: Repair of pre-existing water damage or stripped particle-board screw threads
Wall-mounting of heavy mirrors or headboards into structural masonry
Plumbing connections for integrated washing machines
Custom carpentry modifications to fit smaller room dimensions
priceNotes: Achievable starting price for standard bed frame dismantling and reassembly as an add-on to a house move.

faqs.question: Can you dismantle IKEA PAX wardrobes?
faqs.answer: Yes. IKEA PAX wardrobes and large multi-door flat-pack units are some of the most common items we disassemble and reconstruct during house removals.

faqs.question: What happens to the screws and brackets during transit?
faqs.answer: All fixing hardware, dowels, and screws are placed into dedicated heavy-duty resealable bags and taped directly to the corresponding furniture framework so nothing is misplaced.

faqs.question: Can you dismantle children's bunk beds or cabin beds?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bunk beds and high-sleeper cabin desks are dismantled with care, ensuring every structural support bracket is tagged for correct reassembly.

faqs.question: Do you assemble brand new boxed furniture delivered to our new home?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can assemble newly purchased boxed flat-pack furniture as part of your move service. Simply advise us in advance so we schedule extra technician time.
